verses.html: 40 Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
verses.text: 40 Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”

verses.html: 41 Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
verses.text: 41 Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”

verses.html: 42 And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
verses.text: 42 And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.

verses.html: 43 Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:
verses.text: 43 Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:

verses.html: 44 “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
verses.text: 44 “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”

verses.html: 45 But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.

verses.html: 45 But he, having gone out, began to proclaim much and to report the word, so that he was able no longer to enter into a town openly, but he was out in desolate places, and they were coming to him from all sides.

verses.html: 40 One day, a man who had a skin disease approached Jesus. He bowed down before Jesus and urged him, “{Please heal me!} I know that you can heal me if you want to do so.”
verses.text: 40 One day, a man who had a skin disease approached Jesus. He bowed down before Jesus and urged him, “{Please heal me!} I know that you can heal me if you want to do so.”

verses.html: 41 Jesus pitied the man. So, he stretched out his hand and touched the man. Jesus told him, “I want {to heal you}, and I heal you now!”
verses.text: 41 Jesus pitied the man. So, he stretched out his hand and touched the man. Jesus told him, “I want {to heal you}, and I heal you now!”

verses.html: 42 At that time, Jesus cured the man. He no longer had the skin disease!
verses.text: 42 At that time, Jesus cured the man. He no longer had the skin disease!

verses.html: 43 As soon as {he healed the man}, Jesus commanded him to leave. As he was leaving, Jesus sternly told him,
verses.text: 43 As soon as {he healed the man}, Jesus commanded him to leave. As he was leaving, Jesus sternly told him,

verses.html: 44 “Do not tell anyone what just happened. Instead, go and show yourself to a priest {so that he can examine you and see that you no longer have the skin disease}. Also, present what Moses required you to offer to become ceremonially clean again. This will prove to the community {that you no longer have the skin disease}.”
verses.text: 44 “Do not tell anyone what just happened. Instead, go and show yourself to a priest {so that he can examine you and see that you no longer have the skin disease}. Also, present what Moses required you to offer to become ceremonially clean again. This will prove to the community {that you no longer have the skin disease}.”

verses.html: 45 However, after the man left, he frequently told people about how Jesus had healed him. As a result, people from many different places kept approaching Jesus. So, Jesus could no longer walk into any town publicly. Instead, he stayed outside {the towns} in places where no one lived.
